post.originalText:
AN 11 YEAR OLD IN INDIA POSTED A 12 SECOND SHORT. 123M VIEWS. $17,300 IN UNDER A WEEK.

This is the clip

A collosal titan walking on Earth. Head in the clouds. One foot crushing the coast. City under the spray.

He did not shoot it. He did not hire VFX. He made the still with AI

Then he dropped that still into a video model and told it to move.

Prompt for the image you are looking at:

Colossal Attack on Titan style giant with exposed muscle and no skin standing in Earth orbit above a coastal city, one massive foot stepping into the ocean and throwing a wall of water and cloud, bald head above the atmosphere, photoreal aerial view, tiny buildings under the heel, dramatic sunlight, cinematic IMAX scale

Then the move part is even dumber. Upload that image to any AI video tool. Type animate it. Slow walk. Water exploding. Camera holding the giant in frame.

That is the whole workflow. Still. Animate. Post as a Short.

Kids are doing this from a phone. Studios are still sending quotes.
